description: Bookmarks' settings page shows the saved clip folder's free-space line from Diagnostics' ClipStorage under the Clip folder field, and each of its warnings (LowFreeSpace, FolderUnavailable, FreeSpaceUnknown) as an amber line there, all as the server's text, with the 'Keep free on the clip drive' field after it. clip-guard-probe.mjs runs it while MinFreeSpaceMegabytes is above C:'s free space (a LowFreeSpace warning) and again with the default (none); on its own it checks whatever the sandbox's settings give.

steps.name: Diagnostics has ClipStorage with its line and warnings
the free-space line and the reserve field are filled in
what the page shows
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const s = p.querySelector('#BookmarksClipStorage'); return { line: s.querySelector('.bookmarksClipStorageLine').textContent, warnings: Array.from(s.querySelectorAll('.bookmarksClipStorageWarning')).map(w => ({ code: w.getAttribute('data-code'), text: w.textContent, role: w.getAttribute('role'), children: w.children.length })), reserve: p.querySelector('#MinFreeSpaceMegabytes').value, label: p.querySelector('label[for=MinFreeSpaceMegabytes]').textContent }; })()

steps.name: the line is the server's sentence
the warnings are the server's, in its order, as plain text
the reserve field shows the setting, with its label
steps.assert: String(__vars.shown.reserve) === String(__vars.config.MinFreeSpaceMegabytes) && __vars.shown.label === 'Keep free on the clip drive (MB)'

steps.name: under the Clip folder field, in its container, before the reserve field
steps.assert: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const s = p.querySelector('#BookmarksClipStorage'); const F = Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING; return !!(p.querySelector('#ClipOutputPath').compareDocumentPosition(s) & F) && !!(s.compareDocumentPosition(p.querySelector('#MinFreeSpaceMegabytes')) & F) && s.closest('.inputContainer') === p.querySelector('#ClipOutputPath').closest('.inputContainer'); })()

steps.name: a warning's look: an amber bar and tint (none shown: nothing to look at)
steps.eval: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide) #BookmarksClipStorage .bookmarksClipStorageWarning'); if (!w) return null; const cs = getComputedStyle(w); return { borderLeftStyle: cs.borderLeftStyle, borderLeftWidth: cs.borderLeftWidth, borderLeftColor: cs.borderLeftColor, background: cs.backgroundColor }; })()

steps.name: no warning banner at the top for free space
bring the Clip folder field into view
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
